title: Forbid Extra
statement: Implement `solve(payload, allowed)`. Return `ok` when every payload key is allowed. Return `extra` when any key is not. Missing allowed keys are fine.
hints: Subtract the allowed set from the payload keys.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A model that forbids extra keys turns a typo into a 422 instead of a silently dropped field.

editorial: A model that forbids extra keys turns a typo into a 422 instead of a silently dropped field. The check is set difference. It does not require the payload to contain every allowed key, because those may be optional.
